svg.title: Tuning to requirements
svg.desc: For a 30 second settling time Control Studio chooses its more robust response, which settles within 0.1 degrees after 25.2 seconds; for 15 seconds it chooses the balanced response, which settles after 13.2 seconds and is applied. For 5 seconds it refuses: even its fastest PI would still be 0.57 degrees from the target after 5 seconds, more than the 0.2 degrees allowed.
svg.text: Designed to the requirements, or refused
Control Studio designs on the saved heater model (K 0.2001, τ 5.1 s, L 1 s) · validation on the actual heater program · numbers answer the predictions
λmax = (Ts − L)/ln 30: A 8.53 s, B 4.12 s, C 1.18 s
B: within ±0.1 °C from 13.2 s (predicted 12.6 s); applied
C refused: even the fastest PI is 0.57 °C off after 5 s
